_comment: Copy to ~/.android-use/config.json. Only apps listed here can be opened.
_allow_all_apps: Set to true to disable the allowlist entirely. Not recommended: the phone probably has banking and payment apps on it.
_confirm_risky_actions: Taps that send, pay, delete, call or sign out are held back until repeated with confirm=True. Turning this off is not recommended.
_risky_words: Extra words that make a tap count as risky, for apps that label things unusually or in another language.
